articles.summary: Skyward Specialty Insurance Group announced the appointment of Christopher Zitzmann as president of Inland Marine and Transactional Property. With more than 20 years of industry experience, Zitzmann will lead growth and innovation across these specialized businesses, further strengthening Skyward Specialty’s leadership and underwriting capabilities in the property and inland marine markets.
articles.title: Skyward Specialty Recruits Christopher Zitzmann to Lead Inland Marine and Transactional Property - Skyward Specialty Insurance

articles.summary: Skyward Specialty today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement with the majority sellers to acquire 100% of Apollo Group Holdings Limited (“Apollo”), a specialty insurer operating at Lloyd's of London.
articles.title: Skyward Specialty Insurance Group to Acquire Apollo Group Holdings Limited, Amplifying “Rule Our Niche” Strategy - Skyward Specialty Insurance
